items.rationale: The hole was drilled for the replacement pane, not to repair separate non-glass damage under Clause 2.3. The work follows the glazing exclusion in Clause 2.2, so the payable threshold is €0.
Fitting the pane into the existing frame is part of the excluded glazing work under Clause 2.2, not a repair to the frame under Clause 2.3. The payable threshold is €0.
Clause 2.2 excludes furniture glass breakage even when caused by an accident under Clause 1.1, because the declarations do not include Glass Breakage Cover. The payable threshold is €0.

The visit relates solely to glazing work excluded under Clause 2.2, with no covered non-glass repair under Clause 2.3. There is no covered travel cost to which the €50 claim deductible could apply, so the payable threshold is €0.
